title: Kushanas: more on rulers, Council, coins, legacy

boxes.title: Rulers: added
items: Origin: **Yueh-chi** (Yue-tche) from north-west China, Central Asia
Kujula c. **15-64 CE** (UPSC)
Vima = father of Kanishka; "==Lord of the Whole World=="
Kanishka sought a **Han princess** - refused
Kushanas lost to a ==smaller Chinese force==
Vasudeva I: an **Indian name**

boxes.title: Kanishka's records: added
items: Rabatak found near ==**Surkh Kotal**== (provincial centre)
Rabatak cities also: **Sri Champa**, **Ujjain**
Saka-Vikrama gap **135** years; called Saka era as ==Western Kshatrapas used it==
National calendar **1957**; also **Salivahana Saka**

boxes.title: Council & scholars: added
items: Kundalvana = ==**Harwan**==; earlier councils in Pali/Prakrit
Settled disputes among **Sarvastivada** teachers (Kashmir, Gandhara)
Mahayana: Buddha as god, **idol worship**; Hinayana kept symbols
Shift: Pali-Prakrit Hinayana → ==Sanskrit Mahayana==; spread to China, **Korea**, **Japan**
Ashvaghosha of Pataliputra, poet laureate: also **Sariputrapakaran**
Nagarjuna = "==**Einstein of India**=="; Suhrllekha to a Satavahana king; **Mathara** in court list
First Buddha images: **1st century CE**

boxes.title: Dress, status, legacy
items: Manusmriti: Shakas, Kushans, **Hunas** = =="Fallen Kshatriyas"==
UPSC/NCERT also list **turbans**, **saddles**, armour, **reins**
"Second wave of urbanisation": Mathura, Taxila, Ujjain, **Shravasti**; led into the Gupta age
2026: Kushana coins + **lapis lazuli** near **Takshashila**; stupas at **Zehanpora** (Kashmir)
AP: Nagarjuna tied to **Sriparvata** and the Satavahana court
